verdict.rationale: Opting out of product telemetry is a fair question for a self-hostable observability platform, so the axis applies. The pack has no documented setting, flag, or doc page for disabling SigNoz's own usage tracking. Self-hosting and keeping 'full control of your data plane' is an adjacent deployment property, not a telemetry opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
